trigger: 声明一个后置断言 when its declared inputs are available.

inputs.name: expected_property
inputs.description: Object with required keys `property_name`, `expected_value`, and `relation` for one observable property.

inputs.name: measurement_method
inputs.description: Object with required keys `source_ref`, `method`, `unit`, and `evidence_layer` for measuring that property.

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Object with required keys `value`, `unit`, and `comparison` for the acceptance test.

preconditions: 属性可观察且期望有依据
Use only this single-action procedure; source or upstream instance references must be supplied.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: One 后置断言定义 in the common envelope; data fields: assertion_definition.

postconditions: 通过和失败判据可执行；断言不改变几何
The typed result and provenance agree with the declared single-action scope; unsupported required fields withhold a resolved result.

implementation.target_environment: Source interpretation or strategy reasoning; no SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: No standalone deterministic interpreter is claimed. Apply only MS-08 in the hash-bound guidance reference using atomic-reasoning-protocol.md.

ambiguity_checks: Reject a non-observable expectation or a bundle of multiple independent properties.
Reject incompatible units, invalid tolerances, or a measurement method that is not supplied or traceable.
Do not treat an assertion definition as a measurement result and do not allow the assertion to mutate geometry.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: No geometry handles are acquired; declarations do not mutate or refresh application topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared action inputs cannot support a unique required result.
failure_modes.detection: Apply the action rejection rules and inspect raw source evidence.
failure_modes.safe_state: Return actionable unresolved fields; retain original evidence and values.

recovery.action: Supply only the missing source or prerequisite, then repeat this action; do not invent geometry or start application execution.

validation.method: Inspect named inputs, result fields, procedure and rejection rules for MS-08
validate_atomic_reasoning.py with an actual source manifest; separately review interpretation against raw material.
validation.expected: 通过和失败判据可执行；断言不改变几何

host_checked.notes: Host structure/invariants and bounded independent source evaluation; no automatic promotion.

evidence_level.notes: Candidate. Structural tests cannot establish source interpretation accuracy or any SpaceClaim runtime capability.
